ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher (NS-7); no driver account action required.

rejected_claims.reason: Driver's statement that he was on his way does not support any charge: the fee was levied on a rider cancellation (NS-4), and system records show he was 2597 m away with no 'I'm Here' tap (F1, F3, F4), so no NS-1 no-show conditions were met either.

The rider's claim that the driver was 'nowhere near' is consistent with GPS (F1) but is not the basis of the ruling — NS-4 makes the fee depend only on the 3-minute matching window, not on driver arrival.
